selection_policy.principle: Use the strongest visually justified recipe that preserves a practical reserve instead of maximizing idle headroom.

sd_sdr_progressive.target_gpu_use_guidance: Roughly 50-60% sustained render utilization is acceptable when measured, with approximately 25% or more practical reserve preferred.
sd_sdr_progressive.hard_rule: Do not select from utilization percentage alone.
required_gates: blind visual benefit over the lighter recipe

selection_policy.higher_cost_contexts: Interlaced content, HDR/tone mapping, higher cadence or other GPU-heavy stages require additional reserve and separate qualification.
